ambiguities.source_text: Rank the statuses based on the timestamp (ts) field
ambiguities.intent: Rank timestamps descending within candidate-position pairs; break equal timestamps in input order.

ambiguities.source_text: Count the total number of candidate/positions that have ever been in each status
ambiguities.intent: Count distinct candidate-position pairs ever present in each status.

ambiguities.source_text: Make sure that statuses with no withdrawals are included in the output
ambiguities.intent: Retain all statuses from total counts, including those with no withdrawals; fill missing withdrawal count with zero.

ambiguities.source_text: Calculate the % of candidates who withdrew after each status
ambiguities.intent: Divide withdrawals after a status by distinct candidate-position pairs ever in that status, times 100, rounded to one decimal.
